title: Page 201
transc:
Ft Monroe June 13 1864
R OBrien Gen Butlers Hd Qrs
Appian June fever Emma for Knox unity in consequence of
the orders of Juno received through Lieut paradise Begs sheaf
Vinton here pedlar I this day send back to Saco
how Patton the patenting material brought down yesterday from Burr
moody prolong zodiac the polkaing officer torch trains princess Lubey
is directed to wick to you by letter for orders
on his arrival at Saco how Patton Webster H W
Ben ham palsy zebra zodiac Perkins and building party also
peach operators have been ordered from white horse to wick
to you you can on their arrival build the line
to Saco how patton pedlar will arrange for the Cabal
Persia possible will send material from here zodiac Peru line
from Hastings to white horse is closed and taken down
which will be in few days pekin there will be
plenty of men and material for all emergencies and a
building party to start from James town Smyrna to meet
your party unity plenty of material here for new line
Geo D Sheldon


Washington June 13 1864 
10 PM
Geo D Sheldon
yours of noon today received unity youre
on the ground and should know best
how matters should be directed carry out
such plans as Yuma think necessary and
expedient for the service zebra funds best
T. T. Eckert
